हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/CTNqT7
show.description: Game Over is the gripping journey of Bhavna, an innocent, kind-hearted orphan who is betrayed by her adopted rich family the Singhanias. From being humiliated and disowned to rising as a world-famous Master Healer, Bhavna’s path crosses again with her first love, Karan Thakkar, a powerful billionaire. Love, revenge, and redemption intertwine as the unknown girl becomes the billionaire’s bride proving that true worth shines beyond wealth and bloodlines.
